title: Peremyshl
summary: Peremyshl refers to multiple locations, including a village in Russia and a historical town in Muscovy, with relevance to the broader context of Eastern European geography.

sections.heading: Peremyshl in Russia
paragraphs: Peremyshl is a village located in Kaluga Oblast, Russia.

sections.heading: Historical Context of Peremyshl
paragraphs: Peremyshl also refers to a former town in Muscovy, which is significant in understanding the historical landscape of [[eastern-europe|Eastern Europe]].

sections.heading: Connection to Ukraine
paragraphs: The name Peremyshl is similar to Przemyśl, a city in Poland that has historical ties to [[ukraine|Ukraine]], highlighting the interconnectedness of regional histories.
